story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by knights and knaves. Knights always tell the truth, and knaves always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Grace, and Daniel. "Grace is a knight if and only if Daniel is a knave" - Grace. Daniel stated, "if Grace is a knight then Grace is a knave". So who is a knight and who is a knave? (Format your answer like: "Grace is a knight/knave, and Daniel is a knight/knave")

options: Grace is a knight, Daniel is a knave
Grace is a knave, Daniel is a knave
Grace is a knave, Daniel is a knight
Grace is a knight, Daniel is a knight
